summary: Full remediation of all 4 defects identified in Phase 5.4.16 adversarial audit: fail-closed global budget accounting eliminating token leakage on missing/invalid telemetry, coupled acceptance gate requiring valid telemetry and positive model tokens, test fidelity hardening with orchestrator over-ceiling safety detection, and deterministic CLI execution policy precedence with --no-stop-on-failure deprecation. All 63 offline tests across all 7 test suites pass with 0 failures and 0 errors.

workstream_a_global_budget_fail_closed.defect: Global budget leakage when arm telemetry is missing, unparseable, or invalid (previously accumulated 0 tokens into cumulative_global_tokens).
workstream_a_global_budget_fail_closed.remediation: Implemented fail-closed telemetry validation via Orchestrator.validate_telemetry_integrity. If an arm produces missing, unparseable, or mathematically inconsistent telemetry, the orchestrator immediately halts the block with ABORTED_UNCERTAIN_BUDGET, marks trailing arms SKIPPED_UNCERTAIN_BUDGET, sets global_budget_uncertain=True, and withholds unverified spend from cumulative_global_tokens.

workstream_b_acceptance_gate_coupling.defect: Acceptance gate _is_accepted checked only functional score and requirements passing, ignoring telemetry_valid and execution_status, allowing corrupted runs to resolve to ACCEPTED or DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE.
workstream_b_acceptance_gate_coupling.remediation: Refactored acceptance into static method Orchestrator.is_run_accepted(run_dict) requiring: execution_status == SUCCESS, correctness.score == 1.0, correctness.passed_all_requirements is True, top-level telemetry_valid is True, payload telemetry_valid is True, validate_telemetry_integrity passes, and total_model_tokens > 0. Blocks with uncertain usage resolve to ABORTED_UNCERTAIN_BUDGET with all savings claims invalidated.

workstream_c_test_fidelity_hardening.defect: test_04 mock bypassed effective ceiling (80,000) and returned 120,000 with SUCCESS; orchestrator lacked detection for over-ceiling execution.
workstream_c_test_fidelity_hardening.remediation: Updated test_04 mock to simulate runner ceiling capping (TOKEN_CEILING_BREACHED at 80,000 tokens). Added orchestrator-level over-ceiling safety detection: if an arm reports SUCCESS while consuming more tokens than its effective ceiling, orchestrator raises SafetyViolationError, halts block with ABORTED_SAFETY_FAILURE, and marks trailing arms SKIPPED_SAFETY_FAILURE. Added unit test verifying runner terminates with TOKEN_CEILING_BREACHED at configured ceiling.

workstream_d_cli_policy_precedence.defect: Ambiguous interaction between legacy --no-stop-on-failure and modern --execution-policy flags, permitting conflicting configurations.
workstream_d_cli_policy_precedence.remediation: Implemented resolve_execution_policy helper in orchestrator.py. --execution-policy is the primary control ('strict' default, 'diagnostic_continue'). --no-stop-on-failure is a deprecated legacy alias mapping to 'diagnostic_continue' with a stderr warning. Passing both --no-stop-on-failure and --execution-policy strict fails closed with ArgumentParser exit code 2.
